answer: Insider might register ghost agents using same identity. Mechanism ties each agent's reputation bond to unique on-chain identity with non-transferable soulbound token. That token becomes identity's opal — fragile, singular, irreplaceable. Replication breaks bond, cost equals entire stake. System treats identity theft as fable others study, not repeat. Each agent's verified history forms a haven attackers cannot enter without burning their own stake. Bond re-staking requires fresh identity attestation from independent verifiers, preventing silent reuse.
